detail.requirements:
• Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
• Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)
detail.main_tasks:
• Work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best technical decisions
• Build enduring relationships with customers and establish yourself as a trusted advisor
• Stay current on AWS services across more than 175 service categories
• Advocate with product teams to ensure the right products are built for customers
• Share knowledge broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events
detail.intro: Are you interested in cloud computing and helping customers build on AWS? We have a role you might find interesting. The AWS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with customers as they build and grow their businesses on AWS. We're here to make sure they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible — and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so.
detail.benefits:
• Mentorship and career growth resources
• Work/life balance and flexibility as part of working culture
• Employee-led affinity groups fostering a culture of inclusion
• Ongoing events and learning experiences including CORE and AmazeCon conferences
• Workplace accommodation and adjustment support during application and hiring process
detail.preferred_points:
• Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
• Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

job.position: Associate Solutions Architect, APJ ECT SA (CSC)
